meta.method: Open-source posts on X plus co-presence metrics from multi-year public post archives around the dense hub. Live August 2026 posts banked separately. Centrality is not guilt. Allegations by third parties are labeled ALLEGATION.
meta.disclaimer: This board maps public online speech. It is not a finding of criminal association, intelligence employment, or conspiracy. Legal names attributed by third parties remain unverified unless independently sourced.

findings.title: Multipolar, not a single cell
findings.text: Public speech forms at least three gravity wells: a dense multi-year hub, a companion conflict wing, and a war co-hub. Support often travels via shared adversaries and bridges rather than mutual praise between hubs.

findings.title: Bridge accounts matter more than raw follower counts
findings.text: A small set of accounts appear in more than one wing with supportive or co-combat speech. Those bridges explain connectivity without proving unified command.

findings.title: Null edges are findings
findings.text: Absence of bilateral public posts between some high-profile pairs is material. Do not invent coordination where the public record is empty.

findings.title: Centrality is not guilt
findings.text: A well-connected node is a well-documented speech node. Conclusions require case files and independent verification — not graph aesthetics.

findings.title: A public pressure campaign is a mappable event
findings.text: @ProjPM runs a visible naming and pressure campaign. That speech is a public fact; each substantive claim is a separate verification ticket.

findings.title: War pack is a distinct subgraph
findings.text: Dense co-presence among anti-war-hub accounts (Maynard / Anonfratbro / w0rmer / EvilRabbit class) sits on the dense hub conflict side — not the same as the companion hub Barrett fight.

findings.title: Live collection refreshes the chronicle layer
findings.text: August 2026 posts show @ronbryn chronicling @FuxNet, @FuxNet counterspeech, and @urharmless shared-enemy alignment — active speech, not only historic archive weight.

findings.title: DDoSecrets-adjacent pressure is a separate desk
findings.text: August 2026 serials from @ProjPM name DDoSecrets, Bryan Micon, Maggie Mayhem, and related accounts. Map that cluster separately from the FuxNet hub. Employment and CSAM-adjacent claims stay ALLEGATION.

findings.title: Meeps is dual-orbit, not a command node
findings.text: @meepkittyfuck shows friendly historic speech with the dense hub and separate naming in companion-wing / Barrett narratives. Do not collapse Meeps into FuxNet or Kron leadership. Keep employment claims on isolated tickets.

findings.title: Parent chains make campaign method measurable
findings.text: Hydrated multi-part threads (Micon serial; identity crowdsource; DDoSecrets questions) show serialized pressure as a method. Chain existence is public fact; each content claim is its own ticket.

findings.title: Targets publish counterspeech — bank it at equal method priority
findings.text: Bryan Micon posted a long public statement and an explicit non-involvement denial in response to the August 2026 pressure serial. Map counterspeech as claim tickets, not automatic refutation of every Barrett assertion — and not automatic proof of Micon narrative either.

findings.title: No allegation upgrade without independent primary
findings.text: Wave 5 banks replies and counterspeech only. Employment, asset, and screenshot-authenticity tickets stay ALLEGATION/OPEN until court records, registries, multi-source documentary primaries, or on-record employer confirmation exist.

findings.title: DDo-side counterspeech exists — org silence is still a null
findings.text: @bbhorne has first-person public posts denying current DDoSecrets work and stating a May 2025 exit. No official DDoSecrets organizational account reply to the August 2026 serial was banked this wave. Absence of org reply is a finding, not proof of any conspiracy claim.

findings.title: Attributed quotes are not the quoted person speaking
findings.text: Several Barrett posts attribute statements to Maggie Mayhem. Until a primary Mayhem post is banked, those rows stay third-party attribution tickets. Resolving @MsMaggieMayhem as a public handle is not verification of every attributed sentence.

findings.title: Primary Mayhem speech vs Barrett is older than the 2026 serial
findings.text: @MsMaggieMayhem has first-person 2022 posts criticizing Barrett narratives and volunteer-project staffing. That establishes a public adversarial history. It does not automatically authenticate every 2026 quote Barrett attributes to her — those remain separate OPEN tickets until matching primaries are banked.

findings.title: No verified official DDoSecrets X account in collection search
findings.text: User search for DDoSecrets returned unrelated handles. The org is treated as a named entity from bios, chronicles, and attributions — not as a live X org node with official posts banked this wave.

findings.title: Official DDoSecrets channel is the web, not X
findings.text: Collection maps ddosecrets.org as the official public web presence (about page names Emma Best as co-founder). No verified official X org account was banked. Campaign speech about the org is not the same as an org statement.

findings.title: Primary vs attributed speech must stay split
findings.text: Mayhem has banked primary 2022 posts about Barrett. Separate 2026 quotes Barrett attributes to Mayhem remain unmatched to primary posts. Micon now denies any communication with Mayhem. Map both facts without collapsing them.

findings.title: Display is not the graph — but bad display hides the graph
findings.text: Wave 9 rebuilt the public board for readability (larger canvas, connection-sized nodes, community filters, claim cards). The underlying claim hygiene rules are unchanged: primary vs attributed speech stays split; allegations stay allegations.

findings.title: Pressure threads keep branching — ticket each turn
findings.text: August 10 follow-ups re-assert Mayhem citations and private-convo publication claims against Micon. Micon continues counterspeech and denies Mayhem contact. Each new assertion is a new ticket; volume is not verification.

findings.title: Campaign method includes archival media drops
findings.text: Alongside serial pressure threads, @ProjPM continues public media drops (e.g. Kirtaner-related YouTube). Media drops are public speech events; they do not by themselves verify association or employment claims elsewhere on the ledger.

findings.title: Named conduits without public reply stay sparse nodes
findings.text: Rocco is named in BB attribution speech as a conduit for a Maggie conversation. Until Rocco posts publicly or a primary document appears, the node is a named reference — not a mapped public speaker.

findings.title: Official org roster constrains campaign labels
findings.text: ddosecrets.org/about Team lists Emma Best (co-founder), Micah Lee, Bonaventure, Milo Z. Trujillo, Delfin Mocache Massoko, and Brassy. That is public org self-presentation. Names BB stresses in campaign speech but that do not appear on that page (e.g. Mayhem, Annalise, Fionda) stay on allegation or support-speech tickets — not auto-promoted to verified board/staff.

findings.title: Mayhem public DDoSecrets support is primary — board role is not
findings.text: @MsMaggieMayhem has first-person 2023 fundraising posts for DDoSecrets and lists the org in bio. That is PUBLIC_POST_FACT support speech. BB's board-member claim remains a separate ALLEGATION ticket. Support ≠ verified governance role.

findings.title: NSPM-13 catalogue hit is not DDoSecrets formation proof
findings.text: Public FAS inventory lists NSPM-13 as United States Cyber Operations Policy. BB wrote NPSM-13 as a formation frame for DDoSecrets. Catalogue existence + acronym near-match is a collection note only. CL-46 stays ALLEGATION until a documentary chain links that (or any) policy instrument to org founding.

findings.title: FuxNet name-drop of Rocco is not Rocco self-ID
findings.text: @FuxNet publicly used the name Rocco in August 2026 speech. That expands the named-reference layer. It does not map a verified handle or authenticate BB conduit claims. Self-identification remains the gate for a speaker node upgrade.

findings.title: NSPM-13 is military cyber policy, not a transparency-org charter
findings.text: Public primers (CRS, Army War College class) describe NSPM-13 as United States Cyber Operations Policy for U.S. government offensive cyber / CYBERCOM authorities. That clarifies what the nearest catalogue match is. It does not prove DDoSecrets was formed under that instrument. CL-46 stays ALLEGATION.

findings.title: Dense hub publishes its own Barrett counterspeech
findings.text: @Kronykal has first-person July 2026 posts dismissing Barrett as long-running entertainment/punchline. Bank that as dense-hub counterspeech — separate from the FuxNet wing and from the DDoSecrets-adjacent Micon desk.

findings.title: Research-pointer posts are campaign method, not verification
findings.text: BB publicly tells audiences to read Emma Best's old blog and to question prior Best claims. That is mappable method. Underlying Best statements remain separate OPEN tickets until primary Best posts are banked.

findings.title: Wave 13 re-nulls do not upgrade allegations
findings.text: Fresh keyword search still found no Mayhem primary matching 2026 BB-attributed jailbait/rumor quotes. Web sweep found no independent board-role press for Mayhem. AI voice firm co-founder claim is newly ticketed ALLEGATION only. Absence of confirmations is not proof of falsehood — it blocks upgrades.

findings.title: Campaign runs on dual Barrett handles
findings.text: @ProjPM and @BarrettB both post campaign content in the same window (media, slogans, serial pressure). Treat dual-handle output as one actor's public speech surface for method mapping — still separate claim tickets per assertion.

findings.title: BB states an explicit non-acceptance rule for denials
findings.text: In the identity-crowdsource thread, BB publicly says denials are not confirmation and that he focuses on purported front-end support of police assets rather than later disassociation. That is campaign method. It does not convert asset ALLEGATION tickets into verified employment.

findings.title: Name collisions are not identity maps
findings.text: Searching Rocco returns unrelated public accounts. Until a handle self-identifies in the BB-Micon-Mayhem conduit context, Rocco stays a named-reference sparse node. Auto-mapping common first names would invent false edges.

findings.title: Emma Best has a public writing home — use it for primaries
findings.text: emma.best is a reachable public channel. Future Best-related tickets should prefer first-person posts from that site or verified Best accounts over BB paraphrases. Banking the channel is not banking the attributed claims.

findings.title: Exact attributed quote text is now inventory — still not primary speech
findings.text: BB's screenshot post quotes Mayhem: jailbait rumors + Bryan Micon might have pictures, labeled July 30 2026. Banking the exact wording improves the ticket. It does not convert the row into Mayhem first-person speech.

findings.title: Attributed date window has no Mayhem X posts banked
findings.text: Collection search from:@MsMaggieMayhem across the BB-attributed July 28–Aug 2 2026 window returned no public posts. That strengthens the primary-vs-attributed split. Possible non-X or deleted channels remain open hypotheses — not verdicts of fabrication without more proof.

findings.title: Emma Best publishes first-person Barrett adjacency
findings.text: Best's 2025 Val Broeksmit investigation describes Barrett introducing Val into #29 Leaks research context and other Barrett-adjacent events. That is primary Best journalism about historic adjacency — separate from 2026 Micon serial claims and from NPSM-13 formation allegations.

findings.title: Campaign live stream is stable this pass
findings.text: Wave 15 re-scan found no new ProjPM/BarrettB posts beyond the already-ticketed Aug 9–10 set. When the stream is quiet, advance open primaries (exact quotes, Best archive, corporate claims) rather than inventing motion.

findings.title: Attributed-quote inventory is multi-speaker
findings.text: Beyond Mayhem, BB attributes exact quote texts to Brian Brennan and Cassandra Ford in the same August 5 serial. Each attributed speaker is a separate OPEN ticket. Role labels (Army intel, DDoSecrets) on Brennan stay ALLEGATION until independent primaries exist.

findings.title: Handle equation is not legal-ID lock
findings.text: BB publicly equates Brian Brennan with @camelcitysquid. Cadwalladr's 2018 post names CamelCitySquid as a researcher without locking a legal name on this file. Map both labels on one sparse node; do not treat equation as TENET5-verified identity.

findings.title: Second Mayhem attributed quote also lacks primary
findings.text: Exact text "Why is it that only white boys have suspicious deaths?" is banked as BB attribution. Keyword search of Mayhem's public X timeline found no match. Same hygiene as the jailbait quote: inventory the attribution; do not upgrade.

findings.title: Campaign mixes attribution screenshots with self-referential violence rhetoric
findings.text: BB posts that attribute assault-threat quotes to others also include a first-person line about ordering Brennan ambushed. Bank the text as public method/speech. Do not convert sarcastic or unverified violence claims into verified criminal findings without independent records.

findings.title: Asset and CSAM-adjacent labels stay hard ALLEGATION
findings.text: July campaign posts assert FBI-asset status and blackmail/CSAM-adjacent framing against named accounts including Cassandra Ford and historic scene names. Those are third-party public claims. TENET5 does not promote them as fact; they remain ticketed ALLEGATION until independent primary records exist.

findings.title: CamelCitySquid is archive-referenced, not live-mapped
findings.text: Cadwalladr 2018 and BB 2026 posts name @camelcitysquid. Wave 17 live user/from search did not recover an active matching timeline (near-miss handles are not the same). Keep Brennan node as named-reference until a live self-ID or archive primary appears.

findings.title: Guccifer handle collisions require identity discipline
findings.text: Multiple Guccifer-named accounts exist on X. BB points at @guccifer2 as Cassandra Ford. Historical Guccifer 2.0 is a separate contested persona literature. Map the campaign equation as speech; do not auto-merge with Russiagate persona history as identity fact.

findings.title: Counterspeech on age chronology is first-person public speech
findings.text: @BunnyJ4ck404 publicly challenges BB's Ford timeline by asserting she was a child when the conflict began. Bank as counterspeech. Age claims still need independent records if used as findings beyond speech mapping.
